mof.publication_rule: 15:00 JST observation -> next Japanese business day 09:30 JST publication. At 08:30 JST yesterday is unavailable. Holidays and year-end closures use existing XTKS calendar.
mof.parser: CP932 or UTF-8; named 2年/10年/20年 columns; Showa/Heisei/Reiwa dates; no assumption that columns are positional.
mof.merge_rule: History archive ends at prior month; current-month CSV is required. Current-month rows override archive overlap; conflicting duplicates within one response are errors.
mof.early_response_policy: Rows whose documented publication time is still future are excluded even if the HTTP response contains them.
mof.history_limitation: Downloaded series is current vintage. Original revision values are not available from these CSV files. Historical availability uses published schedule; flags mark unverified historical vintage.

fred.fetch_rule: Use only id parameter and the standard httpx User-Agent; download public rolling history and filter dates locally. Custom application User-Agent caused reproducible timeouts in controlled comparison.
fred.actual_latest_rule: The newest non-missing source observation uses actual fetch completion as FIRST_OBSERVED availability; no backdating to observation close or a presumed release time.
fred.historical_estimate_rule: Older observations use the start (00:00 America/Chicago, with DST) of the second US federal business day strictly after observation. If actually observed earlier, use actual fetch time. This is a conservative engineering estimate, NOT a verified publication SLA.
fred.source_timing_evidence: Official series pages reviewed 2026-10-15 showed 2026-10-13 observation, updated 2026-10-14 10:26 AM CDT. CSV contains observation dates only, without original release timestamps.
fred.history_limitation: Current-vintage values and possible revisions; historical release timestamps and original vintages unverified. Since April 2026 the public ICE histories have a rolling three-year limit. Do not claim an estimated backfill proves actual historical availability.
fred.event_timestamp_policy: Midnight Central is an observation-date anchor only, flagged observation_date_only_event_time; it is not asserted to be an actual exchange close.
fred.freshness_limitation: FRED helper is a conservative lag baseline, not a guaranteed publication calendar. Federal-holiday and month-end weekend observations may occur; helper does not require them.
fred.usage: ICE source terms specify internal use only for Top Level Data and require permission for redistribution. Do not publish raw index observations through an external product without the required rights.
